reviews.comment: She is very sweet but there was a decent amount of work with her class. Just show up and talk to her, she let me have extensions on basically everything and was super caring with her responses and feedback. As long as you put in the effort you shouldn't have to worry.

sweet lady but you have to put work in. she over explains very basic topics, making it confusing to keep up with. LOTS of reading & writing assignments (3+ per week). attendance is mandatory and she will take points off your overall grade if you're not present. a lot of group work & "pair up with a partner & discuss abcd..." not the best class ever

Nance Heise was a very caring professor. The beginning of the semester seemed pretty easy, but the final project was super overwhelming. Attendance is mandatory and you can only miss like two days and if you miss more than that it can really impact your grade. Overall I would say that this class was very confusing at times but manageable.

Overall, Nance is a very kind person. With that being said, I haven't enjoyed her class at all. Whenever I leave I can only think about how much it was a waste of time. I honestly couldn't tell you a single thing I have learned. Also, her grading method is absolutely nuts. Truly wants you to succeed but this class has been frustrating for sure.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Nance Heise is an ANGEL. She effectively teaches the content, and even the the work is tough, she supports you every step of the way. She is encouraging, understanding, and engaging. This class is all groupwork, so make sure you ask the uncomfy questions at the beginning to find the right group for you, don't just pair with friends. Fun class!
For the intro class she was wonderful, very helpful and good at giving feedback.

I took this class thinking it would be decently enjoyable working with groups, but Nance made the coursework VERY overbearing and did not grade very lightly on papers. While taking quizzes/tests/getting lectured you are also doing a very time consuming semester-long group project that 90% of the work is done outside of class. I would not take again

While Professor Heise gave a lot of work, she was very relaxed when it came to student interactions, and the course lectures were extremely helpful and entertaining. Recommended for anyone taking COMM 205, though make sure the rest of the class you're taking it with has people who take the time and effort to participate; otherwise, it's not fun.
